description: Splatter Blocks is a vibrant, fun-filled game where precision meets creativity! Launch adorable cube characters from a springboard into a pool of paint, then splash onto the board to colour in the picture. Aim carefully to match the correct colours and fill in the corresponding squares. The more accurate your painting, the higher your score! Master each level with perfect splashes and unlock new challenges. Simple, stylish, and bursting with character—get ready to paint the town!
name: Splatter Blocks
intro: Aim, splash, and paint the board with colourful cubes for fun and accuracy!
